species.tagline: An ambush hunter of Hong Kong gardens

tasks.title: Look at the front legs
tasks.message: Its front legs are lined with spines — once they close, nothing escapes.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is an Asian mantis. Its spiny front legs snap shut and hold on tight.

tasks.title: Look at the head
tasks.message: It can turn its head almost right round to look behind without moving.
tasks.subtitle: A mantis can swivel its head. It sees behind itself without turning its body.

tasks.title: How to help
tasks.message: A mantis eats pests — it is the garden’s helper.
tasks.subtitle: Mantises eat the pests in a garden. Skipping the bug spray lets them stay. Thank you!
